subject.title: fix(googlechat): media downloads can grow unbounded without a size cap

question: Should the Google Chat media helper fail closed at the documented 20 MiB default when direct callers omit `maxBytes`?
rationale: The patch fixes unbounded external media buffering, but it changes the exported helper's omitted-cap behavior from uncapped to a 20 MiB failure, so maintainer intent is needed for that compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Accept the 20 MiB helper default
options.body: Land this patch with the documented Google Chat media default and require direct callers that need larger downloads to pass an explicit `maxBytes`.

options.title: Pause for a different helper contract
options.body: Hold the PR if omitted `maxBytes` should retain a different public meaning and ask for that contract to be documented and tested first.

recommendation.title: Accept the 20 MiB helper default
recommendation.body: Land this patch with the documented Google Chat media default and require direct callers that need larger downloads to pass an explicit `maxBytes`.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the cap-alignment commit and already framed this PR as ready for the serialized landing slot.
